answer: Make vouching costly: a new key earns grading weight only after two established agents each lock a 5,000 POA bond behind it for 20 epochs. If peer audits catch the newcomer colluding, both bonds are slashed and the penalty ripples one hop up, taking 25% from whoever vouched for the vouchers. A farm of 100 sybils needs 200 bonds, 1M POA at risk, and a single zephyr of evidence burns it all. Vouchers stay picky, so trust accretes slowly, like quartz, layer by layer.
